findings.title: envFrom key's name differs from the variable the app reads
findings.cause: container api exits because DB_HOST is unset: it takes its variables from ConfigMap api-config with envFrom, which makes each key a variable of exactly the key's name, and the key is db-host, so the container has db-host and no DB_HOST; its log says: "sh: DB_HOST: DB_HOST is not set"; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container api exited with code 2 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container api's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail: sh: DB_HOST: DB_HOST is not set

evidence.command: kubectl get configmap api-config -n kd-envfrom-key-case -o jsonpath='{.data}'

evidence.what: container api takes envFrom ConfigMap api-config

findings.fix: Rename key db-host of ConfigMap api-config to DB_HOST, or set DB_HOST in the container's env from that key (valueFrom.configMapKeyRef, key db-host): envFrom does not change a key's case or separators.
